title: Two Save Page Now (SPN2) submission jobs on one account keep hitting 429 together; cap concurrency per job and pass if_not_archived_within
claims_under_test: Two account-authenticated jobs share a rate-limit budget and the undocumented ceiling is low single digits.
if_not_archived_within avoids unnecessary crawls and budget consumption.
The posted queue loop safely requeues 429/503 and continues polling in-flight jobs.
A fixed 900-second backoff is an acceptable starting point but not a server value.
The posted list queue and task handling are bounded, starvation-free, and avoid duplicates.
